instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside a gym with grey padded walls and floor, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) on the left, with his back partially turned, throws a punch at the shirtless man with a mullet (R2) on the right. The shirtless man (R2) faces left, absorbing or blocking the blow. Both fighters wear white shin guards, sparring gloves, and protective eyewear. Bright overhead gym lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the grey floor. No bystanders are visible in this shot.
